preconditions: An invented web worker runs as its local service account; its shell stays alive until the child process starts ten minutes later.
A recurring inventory schedule on the second host starts the same shell/id pair as part of its normal collection, a competing explanation distinguished by parent, account, schedule and elapsed time.
emulation_limitations: Process ancestry proves the child depends on the shell, not an identity or privilege crossing. No persistence or host compromise is demonstrated.
The second host source declares a +3 s clock offset; timestamp_utc is the original time minus that offset.
